verdict.rationale: Lithic's Events API explicitly supports registering/managing webhook URLs, replaying messages, controlling subscription secrets, and searching past events, and sandbox docs confirm webhooks can be run end-to-end; combined with AI-native access via the official MCP server for editor-driven integration, this satisfies the story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of webhook reliability and no explicit doc showing an AI agent subscribing to webhooks specifically via natural language/MCP tool calls.
